Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Candidates planning to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Bharti 2026 must meet all eligibility conditions set by CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd. The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and no upper age limit is mentioned in the official notification. Candidates must hold a valid Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate from a UIDAI-authorized testing and certifying agency.

Educational Qualification

Age Limit

The minimum age to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Operator Vacancy 2026 is 18 years. No maximum age or age relaxation details are mentioned in the official notification.

Mandatory Certificate Requirement

Every applicant must possess an Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a Testing & Certifying Agency authorized by UIDAI for delivering Aadhaar services. Additionally, candidates must have basic computer skills. Candidates who do not yet hold this certificate can appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam through the link: https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action

Salary / Remuneration - CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator 2026

Selected candidates under the CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026 will be paid as per the state government's prescribed wage structure. The remuneration for all selected Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator candidates will be the minimum wages of the respective state set for semi-skilled manpower. The exact figure will vary from state to state based on the applicable minimum wage notification of Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, or Maharashtra.

How to Obtain the Aadhaar Supervisor Certificate Before Applying

Candidates who do not yet hold the mandatory Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate need to complete two steps before they are eligible to apply for CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra jobs. First, they must apply for and pass the Aadhaar Supervisor exam; second, they must complete the LMS certification. Both processes are managed through official UIDAI platforms.

  1. Visit the Aadhaar Supervisor exam portal at https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action and submit your exam application.
  2. An authorization request will be sent to the State Team. Once approved, you will be permitted to appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam.
  3. After your LMS ID and Password are created and approved, appear for the Aadhaar LMS Certification through the portal at https://e-learning.uidai.gov.in
  4. Once certified, proceed to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor district post on the CSC Job Portal.

How to Apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026

The CSC Aadhaar Operator Apply Online 2026 process is conducted entirely through the official CSC Job Portal at career.csccloud.in. Candidates must ensure they have their Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate ready before beginning the application. The last date to apply is 20 August 2026, and no offline applications are accepted under this recruitment.

  1. Visit the official CSC Job Portal at career.csccloud.in.
  2. Navigate to the relevant job post for your state - Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, or Maharashtra.
  3. Click on the "Apply Now" button on the job post page.
  4. Fill in the online application form with your personal, educational, and certification details.
  5. Upload the required documents including your Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate.
  6. Submit the application form before 20 August 2026.

The apply online facility is available for all four states - Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra. Common Mistakes to Avoid in CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026

Many candidates make avoidable errors while applying for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Vacancy 2026 that can lead to rejection of their application. The points below are based on common patterns seen in similar contractual government recruitment drives and are not derived from the official notification.

  1. Applying without a valid UIDAI certificate: The Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate from a UIDAI-authorized agency is a mandatory requirement. Applying without it will result in disqualification.
  2. VLEs applying despite ineligibility: VLEs are explicitly barred from applying. Submitting an application as a VLE wastes your time and will be rejected at the verification stage.
  3. Applying for the wrong district: Each vacancy is district-specific. Ensure you apply for the correct district as per your location and preference.
  4. Incomplete LMS Certification: Candidates sometimes have the Supervisor exam cleared but not the LMS Certification. Both are required before applying.
  5. Submitting incorrect documents: Upload clear, legible scans of your educational certificates and Aadhaar Operator certificate. Blurry or mismatched documents can cause rejection.
  6. Missing the last date: The portal closes applications on 20 August 2026. Do not wait until the last day — technical issues near the deadline are common.
  7. Confusing CSC e-Governance with state government jobs: This is a contractual, not permanent government post. Ensure you understand the terms of engagement before applying.

There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
  • Psychometric Test/Personal Interview (PI): Conducted to assess personality, communication, problem-solving ability, efficiency, and willingness to work in any part of the country. The minimum qualifying marks for PI are 60% for General & EWS category and 55% for other reserved categories.
  • Final Selection: Based on combined scores from the Online Test and/or PI, subject to vacancies available under the respective category.

BoB Professionals Recruitment 2026 Documents Required

Candidates must produce the following original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, at the time of interview or any subsequent stage of selection:

  • Printout of the valid Interview Call Letter
  • System-generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (birth certificate or SSLC/Std. X marksheet)
  • Photo identity proof (PAN Card/Passport/Driving Licence/Voter's Card/Bank Passbook with photo/Aadhaar card, etc.)

  • Caste certificate (for SC/ST/OBC candidates, in the prescribed format)

  • Service/Discharge Book and pension payment order (for Ex-servicemen candidates)
  • No Objection Certificate from current employer (for candidates serving in Government/Quasi-Government/PSU/Bank)
  • Documents supporting work experience (appointment letter, salary slips, relieving letter, etc.)
  • Any other relevant document in support of eligibility

How to Apply for BoB Professionals Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official Bank of Baroda website at www.bankofbaroda.bank.in and go to the Career section → Current Opportunities.
  2. Register online using a valid personal email ID and mobile number, which must be kept active till completion of the recruitment process.
  3. Fill in the online application form carefully, upload a scanned photograph, signature, and supporting documents such as Date of Birth proof, qualification certificates, experience letters, and category certificates, as per the specifications given in the notification.
  4. Verify all details before submitting, since no changes are permitted after clicking the Submit button.
  5. Pay the applicable application fee online through Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI.
  6. On successful payment, download and retain a printout of the e-receipt and the completed application form for future reference.

BoB Professionals Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply, as selected candidates will be posted at the Bank's absolute discretion.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of 12 months.
  • Candidates selected for JMG/S-I posts must execute a service bond to serve for a minimum of 3 years or pay an amount equivalent to three months' gross salary (not exceeding Rs. 2 lakh) if they leave before completing three years.
  • Candidates selected for MMG/S-II, MMG/S-III, and SMG/S-IV posts must execute a similar service bond, with the payable amount not exceeding Rs. 3 lakh.

  • The number of vacancies, including reserved vacancies, is provisional and may vary according to the Bank's actual requirement.

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for CRP CSA-XVI, the 16th Common Recruitment Process for Customer Service Associate (CSA) posts - popularly known as IBPS Clerk Recruitment - in 11 participating Public Sector Banks. The vacancies are for the financial year 2027-28, and online registration opens on 01.08.2026.

Quick answer: IBPS is recruiting for the Customer Service Associate (Clerk) post under CRP CSA-XVI, with indicative state-wise vacancies across 11 public sector banks (not less than 11,403 posts based on the state totals in the notification, though this figure is not stated as a national total in the notification itself - see the Vacancy Details section below). Graduates aged 20–28 years (as on 01.08.2026) can apply. Online registration runs from 01.08.2026 to 21.08.2026, applications are submitted only through the official IBPS website www.ibps.in, and posting is anywhere in India depending on the State/UT a candidate applies for.

IBPS Clerk (CRP CSA-XVI) Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out

IBPS has published the detailed notification for CRP CSA-XVI on its official website. Candidates should read the full notification carefully before applying, since it contains state-wise vacancy breakups, reservation details, and document requirements.

IBPS Clerk Eligibility Criteria

The eligibility conditions below are the basic criteria for applying. IBPS clarifies that qualifying in the CRP and being provisionally allotted to a bank does not guarantee employment - the concerned bank retains the final say on appointment.

Criteria Details
Nationality Citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01.01.1962, or a person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India
Age (as on 01.08.2026) Minimum 20 years, Maximum 28 years (born not earlier than 02.08.1998 and not later than 01.08.2006)
Educational Qualification (as on 21.08.2026) A Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a University recognised by the Government of India, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government
Local Language Proficiency Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding the specified/opted local language of the State/UT they apply for (see Local Language Proficiency Test section)
Computer Literacy Mandatory - a Certificate/Diploma/Degree in computer operations, or having studied Computer/IT as a subject in High School/College

IBPS Clerk Qualification for Ex-Servicemen

Ex-Servicemen who do not hold the above civil qualification are eligible if they are matriculate Ex-Servicemen who obtained the Army Special Certificate of Education (or the equivalent Navy/Air Force certificate) after completing at least 15 years of service in the Armed Forces, with the certificate dated on or before 21.08.2026.

IBPS Clerk Age Limit

The standard age limit is 20 to 28 years as on 01.08.2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit is available to reserved categories as follows:

Widows, divorced women, and women legally separated (not remarried) Age concession up to 35 years for General/EWS, 38 years for OBC, 40 years for SC/ST

Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates is available cumulatively with only one of the other relaxation categories listed above (Point II 3 to 5 of the notification), not with more than one.

IBPS Clerk Application Fee

  • SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/DESM candidates: ₹175
  • All other candidates: ₹850

Bank transaction charges for online payment are to be borne by the candidate. Payment can be made via Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets, or UPI. A correction fee of ₹200 (inclusive of GST) applies if a candidate uses the Edit Window to modify the submitted application.

The Customer Service Associate is eligible for allowances and perquisites as per the rules of the participating bank in force from time to time. Exact take-home pay after allowances is not specified in the notification, since it varies bank to bank.

IBPS Clerk Selection Process

Selection for CRP CSA-XVI is a two-tier process consisting of an Online Preliminary Examination and an Online Main Examination, followed by a qualifying Local Language Proficiency Test before joining.

Preliminary Examination (Objective Test)

General English English 40 40 35 minutes
Reasoning Ability English/Hindi (as opted) 40 60 35 minutes
Quantitative Aptitude English/Hindi (as opted) 40 50 35 minutes
Total - 160 200 125 minutes

There is a penalty of one-fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to a question for each wrong answer in both the Preliminary and Main Examinations. No penalty applies to unattempted questions. Candidates must clear individual cut-offs in each test as well as an overall cut-off. Only marks obtained in the Main Examination are considered for the final merit list; Preliminary Exam marks are used only for shortlisting.

Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT)

Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the State/UT they apply for. Candidates who have studied that language up to Class 10 or above are exempt from a separate test. Others must clear a qualifying (marks-based) Local Language Proficiency Test conducted after the Main Exam/provisional allotment but before joining - failing this test means disqualification from the process.

Provisional Allotment

Shortlisted candidates are provisionally allotted to one of the participating banks based on merit-cum-preference and State/UT-wise vacancies reported to IBPS. A reserve list of approximately 30% of vacancies in each category may also be maintained, though this does not guarantee eventual allotment. Provisional allotment is subject to identity verification and the candidate being found medically fit and otherwise eligible by the allotted bank.

The following original documents (with self-attested photocopies) must be produced at the time of joining/document verification, as applicable:

  • System-generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Class X certificate with DOB)
  • Photo identity proof as specified in the notification
  • Graduation mark-sheets and degree certificate

  • Caste certificate in the prescribed format (for SC/ST/OBC-NCL candidates)

  • Ex-Servicemen certificates as per Proforma A/B/C/D, as applicable
  • No Objection Certificate (for candidates already in Government/PSU service)
  • Any other document supporting the claimed eligibility

How to Apply for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only - no other mode of application is accepted.

  1. Visit the official IBPS website www.ibps.in and open the "CRP CSA" link, then click "Click Here to Apply Online for CRP – Customer Service Associates (CRP-CSA-XVI)".
  2. Click "Click Here for New Registration" and enter basic details to generate a provisional registration number and password (also sent by email/SMS).
  3. Upload the required scanned documents: photograph, signature, left thumb impression, a handwritten declaration, SSC/SSLC/10th standard or equivalent certificate, and the certificate mentioned in Clause K(ix) if applicable - as per the specifications in Annexure IV of the notification.
  4. Carefully fill in all sections of the online application form using the "Save and Next" facility to verify details before final submission, since most fields cannot be edited after submission.
  5. Indicate the State/UT for which you want to be considered for provisional allotment - this choice is irrevocable once submitted.
  6. Pay the application fee/intimation charges online through the integrated payment gateway (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/IMPS/Wallets/UPI).
  7. On successful payment, take a printout of the e-receipt and the completed application form for your records.

The mock test is designed according to the latest IBPS Clerk exam pattern and helps candidates practice important questions, improve speed, accuracy, and time management before the Preliminary and Main examinations.

IBPS Clerk Mock Test Link 2026

  • Fields such as Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, State/UT (vacancy, correspondence and permanent address), Post, and Nationality cannot be edited after submission.
  • A 2-day Edit Window is provided after the registration closing date to correct other details, for a fee of ₹200; dates for this window will be announced separately on the official website.
  • Not more than one application is allowed per candidate; in case of multiple applications, only the latest completed one is considered valid.
  • Any resulting dispute is subject to the sole jurisdiction of courts situated at Mumbai.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.

Union Bank of India Recruitment 2026: Age Limit

Age limits vary post-wise as detailed in the tables above. The cut-off date for age eligibility is 01.07.2026 (the first day of the month in which online registration commences).

Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC is cumulative with only one of the remaining categories (PwBD/Ex-servicemen/1984 riot-affected). There is no reservation for Ex-servicemen in the Officers' Cadre vacancies.

In addition to basic pay, Special Allowance, Dearness Allowance, and other allowances are payable per the Bank's rules. Union Bank of India Recruitment 2026: Selection Process

For posts up to Scale III, selection may comprise Online Examination, Group Discussion (if required), and/or Personal Interview, depending on the number of applicants. For posts in Scale IV, V, and VI, selection may comprise Group Discussion (if required), any other test/assessment, and/or Personal Interview. The Bank reserves the right to add, cancel, or modify the selection method for any notified post.

Online Examination Structure - Specialist Officers (Post Codes S01–S108, up to Scale III)

Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
Professional Knowledge relevant to the post 50 (MCQ) 100 60 minutes

Online Examination Structure - General Banking Officers (Post Codes G01–G19, up to Scale III)

Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
Quantitative Aptitude 25 25 120 minutes
Reasoning 25 25
English Language 25 25
Professional Knowledge relevant to the post/domain 50 100
Total 125 175  

Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, and English Language sections are qualifying in nature - marks in these are not counted toward final merit. All tests except English Language are available bilingually (English and Hindi). Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General/EWS categories, 35% for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD), subject to the Bank's discretion. There is a penalty of 25% of the marks assigned to a question for each wrong answer; unattempted questions carry no penalty.

Personal Interview

A Personal Interview of 100 marks assesses academic and job knowledge, power of expression, clarity of thought, leadership qualities, communication skills, and suitability for the post. Minimum qualifying marks: 50 for General/EWS, 45 for Reserved Category (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD). Candidates are called for interview in the ratio of 1:3 against the number of vacancies (subject to change at the Bank's discretion).

Final Merit

Final selection is based on the aggregate marks of Online Examination and Personal Interview (or Personal Interview alone, or GD/other assessment plus Personal Interview, depending on which stages are conducted), prepared in descending order category-wise, up to the number of vacancies. In case of a tie, the candidate senior in age (earlier date of birth) is ranked higher.

Union Bank of India Recruitment 2026: Documents Required

  • Printout of the valid Interview Call Letter
  • System-generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Std. X Certificate with DOB)
  • Photo Identity Proof (PAN Card/Passport/Permanent Driving Licence/Voter's Card/Bank Passbook with photo/Aadhaar, etc. - Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are NOT accepted)
  • Mark sheets and certificates/degree for educational qualifications
  • Latest Caste Certificate (for SC/ST/OBC candidates, in prescribed Government format)
  • OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026 (for OBC candidates)
  • Income & Asset Certificate based on FY 2025-26, valid for FY 2026-27 (for EWS candidates)
  • Disability certificate in prescribed format (for PwBD candidates)
  • Scribe declaration form, if services of a scribe were used
  • Discharge book/pension payment order (for Ex-servicemen)
  • No Objection Certificate from employer (for candidates serving in Government/PSU/Bank)
  • Experience certificate in the prescribed format (Annexure-II of the notification), issued by the Competent Authority of the employer, clearly stating period, post held, and nature of duties

Appointment letters, salary certificates, and pay slips are not accepted as proof of work experience.

Union Bank of India Recruitment 2026: How to Apply

  1. Visit the official website www.unionbankofindia.co.in and click on the 'Recruitment' page.
  2. On the Career Overview page, click 'Click to View the Current Recruitment' to open the link "UNION BANK RECRUITMENT PROJECT 2026-27 (OFFICERS WITH DOMAIN EXPERTISE, GENERAL BANKING OFFICERS & SPECIALIST OFFICERS)".
  3. Click on "CLICK HERE TO APPLY ONLINE" to open the online application form.
  4. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your Name, contact details, and Email ID. Note down the system-generated Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  5. Use the "SAVE AND NEXT" option to fill the application in stages if needed, and verify all details carefully - no changes are allowed after clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION".
  6. Upload photograph, signature, and left thumb impression as per the prescribed specifications.
  7. Fill in the remaining application details, preview the form, and click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION".
  8. Click on the "Payment" tab and pay the applicable application fee online.
  9. Click 'Submit' and save/print the system-generated application form and e-receipt for future reference.

Candidates can apply for only one post. Only the last valid, complete application will be retained in case of multiple submissions. An application, once submitted, cannot be withdrawn, and the fee is non-refundable.

Union Bank of India Recruitment 2026: Important Instructions

  • Application can be made for only one post; multiple appearances for a single post at interview will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • No change of category will be permitted at any stage after registration of the online application.
  • Existing Union Bank of India employees may apply through proper channel (HR Department of Regional/Zonal Office) and, if selected, must resign and rejoin the Bank's service afresh.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years of active service.
  • Selected candidates for posts G01–G19 must execute a Service Indemnity Bond to serve the Bank for a minimum of 3 years, or pay ₹2,00,000 plus applicable taxes if they leave before completing 3 years.
  • Selected candidates for posts S01–S108 must execute a Service Indemnity Bond to serve the Bank for a minimum of 3 years, or pay ₹2,50,000 plus applicable taxes if they leave before completing 3 years.
  • Selected candidates shall be posted at any Branch/Office of the Bank throughout India at the Bank's sole discretion.
  • The Bank reserves the right to change/modify the number of vacancies, examination structure, or cancel the recruitment process at any stage.
  • Any dispute arising out of the notification is subject to the sole jurisdiction of courts in Mumbai.

17 Tripura Bengali/Kokborok 18

Note: PwBD figures shown are the total reserved across OC (Orthopedically Challenged), HI (Hearing Impaired), VI (Visually Impaired), and ID (Intellectual Disability) categories combined, as per the official table. Refer to the official notification PDF for the exact category-wise PwBD split for each state.

Key Points on Vacancy Distribution

  • Candidates belonging to reserved categories for which no vacancy has been announced in a state may apply against Unreserved (UR) vacancies of that state, if they meet UR eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates can apply for a vacancy in one state only. Applying against one state makes a candidate ineligible to apply against any other state.
  • The merit list will be drawn state-wise and category-wise.
  • Selected candidates will be posted within the selected state until completion of nine (9) years of service or promotion to SMG Scale IV, whichever is earlier.
  • Prior experience will not be considered for seniority in service.
  • PwBD reservation is on a horizontal basis; selected PwBD candidates will be placed in their applicable category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/UR) and posted within the state applied for, at locations identified suitable by the Bank.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality/Citizenship

An applicant must be:

  • A citizen of India, or
  • A subject of Nepal, or
  • A subject of Bhutan, or
  • A Tibetan Refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, or Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India.

Candidates in the last four categories must have a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India before the date of this notification, and must also be proficient in the local language of the state applied for.

Candidates who have completed their graduation in any discipline can also explore more Bank Officer Jobs and Graduate Government Jobs available across India.

Age and Educational Qualification

Post Scale Age (Years) Educational Qualification
Local Bank Officer (LBO) JMGS-I Min: 20, Max: 30 Graduate in any discipline from a University/Institution recognized/approved by the Government of India or its regulatory bodies

The candidate must possess a valid Mark-sheet/Degree Certificate confirming graduate status on the day of registration, and must indicate the percentage of marks obtained in Graduation while registering online.

Local Language Requirement

Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, and speaking the specified local language of the state for which they are applying (as listed in the state-wise vacancy table). A Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT) will be conducted by an external agency for candidates who have not studied the local language as a subject in Class 10 or Class 12.

Post-Qualification Experience

  • Candidates must possess a minimum of one year of post-qualification work experience in Clerical/Officer Cadre in any Scheduled Commercial Bank or Regional Rural Bank listed in the Second Schedule of the RBI Act, 1934.
  • One advance increment is payable for each completed prior year of service as an Officer in Scheduled Commercial Banks (subject to a maximum of 2 increments), if the job profile matches that of a Scale-I Generalist Officer of PNB.
  • Candidates from subsidiaries of Scheduled Commercial Banks (Officer cadre) are eligible for only one advance increment under the same condition.
  • Proof of prior experience must be submitted in the prescribed format, duly certified by the previous employer.
  • Experience in other financial institutions will not be considered if the job profile does not substantially match that of a PNB Scale-I Generalist Officer.
  • No prior service/experience will be considered for seniority purposes.

Cut-off Dates for Eligibility

  • Age: Reckoned as on 01.07.2026
  • Mandatory Experience: Reckoned as on the closing date for online registration, i.e., 09.08.2026
  • Educational Qualification: Reckoned as on the closing date for online registration, i.e., 09.08.2026
  • The result of the qualifying examination must have been declared on or before 09.08.2026.
  • Candidates must indicate the percentage obtained in Graduation to the nearest two decimals; CGPA/OGPA must be converted to percentage as per the university's official conversion formula. A fraction of percentage will be ignored (e.g., 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%).

Also Read: IBPS SO Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 745 IT Officer, Agricultural Field Officer and More Posts

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Age Relaxation

Sr. Category Age Relaxation
(i) Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe 05 Years
(ii) Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) 03 Years
(iii) Persons with Benchmark Disability 10 Years
(iv) Ex-Servicemen/Commissioned Officers (ECOs/SSCOs with min. 5 years military service) 05 Years
(v) Persons affected by 1984 riots 05 Years

The maximum age limit is applicable to Unreserved (UR) and EWS category candidates. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL) is allowed cumulatively with only one of the remaining categories under (iii) to (v) above. Candidates seeking relaxation must submit the necessary certificates at the time of Interview and at any subsequent stage as required by the Bank.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026: Salary and Perquisites

Selected candidates will draw pay in the scale of Rs. 48480-2000/7-62480-2340/2-67160-2680/7-85920 under JMGS-I. In addition to Basic Pay, selected candidates will be entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA), City Compensatory Allowance (CCA), HRA/Leased Accommodation, Leave Fare Concession, Medical Insurance, Retirement Benefits, and other perquisites as per Bank rules.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

Category Fee Amount (per candidate)
SC/ST/PwBD category candidates Rs. 50/- + GST @18% = Rs. 59/- (only postage charges)
All others (UR/OBC(NCL)/EWS) Rs. 1000/- + GST @18% = Rs. 1180/-

Payment is accepted only through online mode (Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets, or UPI). Bank transaction charges for online payment are to be borne by the candidate. The fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances and cannot be reserved for any other examination.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection for the post of Local Bank Officer shall be conducted in four phases. The Bank reserves the right to decide whether all or any of these modes shall be adopted:

  1. Online Written Test
  2. Screening
  3. Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT), if applicable
  4. Personal Interview

Online Written Test Structure

Name of the Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Sectional Duration (Minutes)
Reasoning & Computer Aptitude 25 25 35
Data Analysis & Interpretation 25 25 35
English Language 25 25 25
Quantitative Aptitude 25 25 35
General/Economy/Banking Awareness 50 50 50
  • There is negative marking: one-fourth of the marks assigned to each question is deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General/EWS category, 35% for Reserved category, in each section. The Bank reserves the right to revise this at its discretion.

Screening

The online application and submitted documents of written-test-qualified candidates will be scrutinized to confirm eligibility before the Language Proficiency Test/Interview. Candidates found ineligible or with incorrect/false documents at any stage will be rejected from further participation.

Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT)

  • Candidates who have not studied the applied-for state's local language as a subject in Class 10 or 12 must appear for the LLPT.
  • The LLPT is qualifying in nature; candidates must secure the Bank-prescribed minimum qualifying marks to be considered for final selection.
  • Candidates who fail to qualify the LLPT are treated as ineligible for final selection, irrespective of performance in other stages.
  • Candidates who indicate they studied the local language in Class 10/12 are exempt from LLPT, subject to submission of valid documentary evidence at verification.

Personal Interview

  • All candidates shortlisted after qualifying the Online Written Test will be called for interview.
  • The Personal Interview carries 50 marks.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 45% (22.50 marks) for SC/ST candidates; 50% (25 marks) for other candidates.
  • Candidates who fail to secure minimum qualifying marks in the interview will be disqualified.

Final Selection

  • Final selection is based on combined performance in the Online Written Test and Personal Interview, subject to qualifying the LLPT (where applicable).
  • Candidates who fail the LLPT are ineligible for final selection even if they qualify in the written test and interview.
  • The merit list is prepared state-wise and category-wise.
  • In case of a tie, the older candidate (by date of birth) is placed higher in the merit list.

The Bank reserves the right to cancel, add, or modify any examination centre.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Required Documents

The following original documents, along with a self-attested photocopy, must be produced at the time of interview:

  • Printout of the valid Interview Call Letter
  • Valid system-generated printout of the Online Application form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Std. X Certificate with DOB)
  • Photo Identity Proof and Address Proof (Officially Valid Documents)
  • Semester-wise/Year-wise Mark sheets and final Degree/Diploma Certificate, with proof of result declaration on or before 09.08.2026
  • Income and Asset Certificate (for EWS candidates)
  • Caste Certificate (for SC/ST/OBC candidates, in the prescribed format, matching the Central Government list letter by letter)
  • Disability Certificate (for PwBD candidates, issued by the District Medical Board)
  • Discharge Certificate/Service Book and Pension Payment Order (for Ex-Servicemen)
  • No Objection Certificate (for candidates serving in Government/PSU/Financial Institutions)
  • Experience Certificate in the prescribed format, along with appointment letter, salary slips, relieving letter, etc.
  • Any other relevant documents in support of eligibility

How to Apply for PNB LBO Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB website: https://pnb.bank.in/, under Recruitment/Career.
  2. Click "CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION" and enter basic personal details to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password (also sent via Email/SMS).
  3. Re-login using the Provisional Registration Number and Password to complete the application form.
  4. Upload scanned images of photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per prescribed specifications (see below).
  5. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to verify details before clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" - no changes are allowed after this step.
  6. Pay the applicable application fee through the online payment gateway (Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, IMPS, Wallets, or UPI).
  7. On successful payment, an e-receipt will be generated.
  8. Take a printout of the submitted application form and e-receipt for personal record; do not send these to the Bank.

Applications are accepted online only, from 20.07.2026 to 09.08.2026, through https://pnb.bank.in/. No other mode of application will be accepted.

Document Upload Specifications

Document Dimensions File Size Format
Photograph 4.5cm × 3.5cm (200 x 230 pixels preferred) 20KB – 50KB JPG/JPEG
Signature 140 x 60 pixels preferred 10KB – 20KB JPG/JPEG
Left Hand Thumb Impression 3cm x 3cm (240 x 240 pixels, 200 DPI) 20KB – 50KB JPG/JPEG
Hand-written Declaration 10cm x 5cm (800 x 400 pixels, 200 DPI) 50KB – 100KB JPG/JPEG
Caste/Disability Certificate - Not exceeding 500KB PDF
Educational Qualification Documents - Not exceeding 500KB PDF
Work Experience Documents - Not exceeding 500KB PDF

The photograph must be a recent passport-style colour picture with a light-coloured background; caps, hats, and dark glasses are not acceptable (religious headwear is allowed if it doesn't cover the face). The signature and hand-written declaration must NOT be in capital letters. Candidates must also capture a live photograph via webcam or mobile phone during registration.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026: Important Instructions

  • Candidates who have earlier worked in PNB or its merged/amalgamated entities and were discharged for reasons other than VRS/Resignation are not eligible to apply.
  • Candidates against whom there are adverse reports regarding character, antecedents, or moral turpitude are not eligible to apply.
  • There is no reservation for Ex-Servicemen in direct recruitment to Officer Cadre; however, age relaxation applies as per Government guidelines.
  • Selected candidates must execute an Indemnity Bond to serve the Bank for at least 3 years, or pay Rs. 2,00,000/- if they leave before completing 3 years of service.
  • Candidates must maintain a minimum CIBIL score of 680 or above at the time of joining. This is not a pre-condition to apply, and candidates with no bank account are not required to produce CIBIL status.
  • Selected candidates will be designated "Local Bank Officer" and will be on probation for 2 years from the date of joining.
  • After induction training, LBOs will be deployed within the Circles of the state for which they were selected, and will remain posted in that state until completion of 9 years of service or promotion to SMG Scale IV, whichever is earlier.
  • No Travelling Allowance is payable for the Online Test and LLPT. Unemployed SC/ST candidates called for interview will be paid actual to-and-fro 2nd Class Rail/Ordinary Bus fare.
  • Candidates must possess a valid Aadhaar card; the Bank may conduct Aadhaar verification at various stages.
  • Any dispute arising from this recruitment is subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated at NCT of Delhi.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any stage without prior notice.

Punjab National Bank (PNB) has released the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 for candidates who appeared in the Local Bank Officer (LBO) online written examination held on 4 January 2026. The individual scorecard link went live on the official recruitment page on 1 August 2026 and can be accessed through a registration-based login on the ibpsreg.ibps.in portal. This article explains how to download your scorecard, what it contains, the qualifying marks, and the last date to access it.

What the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 Contains

The individual scorecard is a diagnostic document distinct from the result PDF. It is issued to candidates who appeared in the online written test, regardless of whether they ultimately qualified. It typically displays:

  • Candidate's roll number and registration number
  • Section-wise marks scored in the online written examination
  • Overall/aggregate marks
  • Qualifying status (Qualified / Not Qualified) for that stage

Also Read: UP TGT 2026 Special Document Verification Admit Card

How to Download PNB LBO Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB recruitment page at pnb.bank.in, or go directly to the ibpsreg.ibps.in scorecard login portal.
  2. Locate the notice titled "Link to View Individual Scorecard" under the Local Bank Officer recruitment section.
  3. Enter your Registration Number / Application Number in the first field.
  4. Enter your Password, or your Date of Birth in DD-MM-YYYY format, in the second field.
  5. Click the Login/Submit button.
  6. Your section-wise scorecard will be displayed on screen.
  7. Download the PDF, or use Ctrl+P to save it as a PDF if no direct download option is shown.
  8. Take a printout and store it safely you will need it during document verification and joining formalities.

PNB LBO Written Exam Qualifying Marks (Cut Off)

As reported by exam-preparation portals covering this recruitment cycle, candidates were required to clear both an overall cut off and a minimum sectional cut off in the online written test:

Category Minimum Marks Required Per Section
General / EWS 40%
SC / ST / OBC / PwBD 35%

Note: These sectional cut off percentages are drawn from exam-reporting sources and are consistent with the standard IBPS-pattern cut off structure used in this recruitment; they are Not Available Officially as an explicitly stated figure on PNB's own notice text reviewed for this article. Candidates should cross-check exact figures against their own scorecard.

Separately, some exam-prep sources report an interview qualifying score of 25 out of 50 for General category candidates and 22.5 out of 50 for SC/ST candidates. This detail is Not Available Officially on PNB's recruitment notice board and should be treated as unconfirmed until verified against the official result document.

  • Valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Driving License, etc.)
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • Proof of post-qualification banking experience (as applicable to the LBO eligibility criteria)
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD), if applicable
  • Recent passport-size photographs

  • The scorecard link is active only for a limited window (1 August to 31 August 2026). Download it before the window closes.
  • Use your registration number rather than your name to search for your record, since candidate names can repeat.
  • Report any discrepancy in personal details on the scorecard to PNB/IBPS immediately rather than proceeding with an incorrect document.
  • PNB has issued a public notice warning candidates against paying any money to anyone for interview calls, selection, or appointment. The bank does not charge any fee for these purposes.
  • Keep your scorecard along with your final result document for document verification and joining formalities.

Why Was the Reserve List Released?

After the CRP RRBs-XIV final result, a primary list of selected candidates was allotted to participating rural banks. However, some sanctioned posts remained vacant because certain selected candidates did not join within the deadline, resigned soon after joining, or were excluded during document verification. To ensure these vacancies are filled, IBPS has released this reserve list for candidates who cleared the exam but were not allotted a bank in the first round.

How to Check IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026

  1. Visit the official IBPS website at ibps.in.
  2. Click on the "IBPS RRB CRP-CSA (Customer Service Associate)" link on the homepage.
  3. Select "CRP-CRP XIV – Provisional Allotment under Reserve List for CRP-CRP XIV."
  4. Enter your Registration No/Roll No and Password/Date of Birth.
  5. Enter the captcha code and click Login.
  6. Check your provisional allotment status and download it for future reference.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Candidates provisionally allotted from the reserve list will also receive an intimation email and SMS on their registered contact details.
  • The allotment shown after login is provisional and will be confirmed only after the concerned bank completes document and eligibility verification.
  • Specific documents required for verification are not listed in the official notification. Candidates should follow the instructions issued directly by their allotted bank.
  • Candidates should keep checking their registered email and SMS regularly to avoid missing further communication or deadlines.

What Happens After Reserve List Allotment?

Based on the notification, candidates allotted through the reserve list can expect the following process, though exact dates and requirements are not specified:

  • Document Verification
  • Submission of Required Certificates
  • Medical Examination (if applicable)
  • Joining Formalities
  • Induction/Training Process

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility to Apply

KRCL Recruitment 2026 is open to the following categories of candidates:

  • Land Loser Candidates: Candidates whose land was acquired for construction of the Konkan Railway Line between Roha (Maharashtra) and Thokur (Karnataka), irrespective of the percentage of land lost. The land loser and/or their spouse, son, daughter, grandson, or granddaughter are eligible under the landloser quota.
  • Employment Exchange Registered Candidates: Domiciles of Maharashtra, Goa, or Karnataka with valid employment exchange cards registered along the Konkan Railway route (Raigad, Sindhudurg, and Ratnagiri districts of Maharashtra; Goa State; Uttara Kannada, Udupi, and Dakshina Kannada/South Kannada districts of Karnataka).
  • Other Domicile Candidates: Candidates domiciled in the States of Maharashtra, Goa, or Karnataka (not covered above).
  • KRCL Employees: Serving KRCL employees who have completed at least 3 years of regular service.

Note: Recruitment in the erstwhile Group-D post - Track Maintainer - is limited to eligible Land Loser candidates only.

Preference in Recruitment

Candidates securing the minimum qualifying marks are given preference for recruitment in the following order:

  1. Land Loser candidates (first preference)
  2. Candidates registered in Employment Exchanges along the KR route (second preference)
  3. Candidates domiciled in Maharashtra, Goa, or Karnataka, and KRCL employees (third preference)

Candidates must declare their status (Land Loser/Employment Exchange/Domicile) at the time of application; this choice is final. The second and third panels are operated only after exhausting the panel of eligible land losers.

PwBD candidates applying against UR vacancies get age relaxation applicable only for PwBD (UR), subject to suitability conditions. Candidates eligible for relaxation on more than one ground get the benefit of the category with maximum relaxation only - not cumulative.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Salary / Pay Scale

Selected candidates will be placed in the following Pay Levels as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix:

Post Group Pay Level (7th CPC) Initial Pay (Rs.)
Senior Section Engineer (S&T) C Level 7 44,900
Senior Section Engineer (Mechanical) C Level 7 44,900
Junior Engineer (Civil) C Level 6 35,400
Junior Engineer (Mechanical) C Level 6 35,400
Section Controller C Level 6 35,400
Station Master C Level 6 35,400
Commercial Supervisor C Level 6 35,400
Goods Train Manager C Level 5 29,200
Technician-III (Mechanical) C Level 2 19,900
ESTM-III (S&T) C Level 2 19,900
Assistant Loco Pilot C Level 2 19,900
Track Maintainer-IV D Level 1 18,000

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Reservation Policy

This notification provides Vertical Reservation for SC, ST, OBC-NCL, and EWS, and Horizontal Reservation for Ex-Servicemen (Ex.SM) and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD).

  • EWS Reservation: Candidates not covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL reservation, whose family gross annual income is below Rs. 8 lakh and who do not own specified categories of land/property, can claim EWS reservation with a valid Income & Asset Certificate.
  • Note: EBC and EWS are different categories - EBC candidates get fee concession only, not job reservation.
  • Horizontal Reservation: Ex-Servicemen and PwBD reservations are included within the post-wise vacancies shown above, irrespective of social community. Ex.SM and PwBD candidates can also apply against unreserved vacancies of posts not exclusively earmarked for them (PwBD candidates only where the post is indicated as suitable for their disability), and are eligible for age relaxation and fee exemption.
  • PwBD Categories: VI (Visually Impaired: Blind/Low Vision), HI (Hearing Impaired: Deaf/Hard of Hearing), LD (Locomotor Disability: One Arm/One Leg/One Arm-Leg/Dwarfism) - subject to a minimum of 40% disability. One Commercial Supervisor post is reserved for PwBD candidates.
  • EWS, SC, ST, and OBC-NCL candidates who qualify without relaxed standards will not be adjusted against reserved vacancies and will be considered under UR.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern (CBT)

The recruitment process varies by post group:

  • Section Controller, Station Master, Assistant Loco Pilot: CBT → Computer-Based/OMR-based Aptitude Test → Document Verification (DV) → Medical Examination. Merit is prepared with 70% weightage to CBT marks and 30% to Aptitude Test marks.
  • Senior Section Engineer (Mechanical/S&T), Junior Engineer (Civil/Mechanical), Goods Train Manager, Commercial Supervisor, Technician-III (Mechanical), ESTM-III: CBT → Document Verification → Medical Examination.
  • Track Maintainer: CBT → Document Verification → Physical Efficiency Test (PET) → Medical Examination.

The CBT is of screening nature with negative marking - one mark is deducted for each wrong answer. Questions are set in five languages: English, Hindi, Marathi, Konkani, and Kannada (the Aptitude Test for SCOR/SM/ALP is in English and Hindi only).

CBT Pattern by Post (Duration & Question Count)

Post Duration Total Questions/Marks
Senior Section Engineer (S&T / Mechanical) 90 minutes 100 (General Science, Basic Maths, General Awareness & Reasoning - 50 marks; Technical Ability - 50 marks)
Junior Engineer (Mechanical) 90 minutes 100 (General topics - 70 marks; Technical Ability - 30 marks)
Junior Engineer (Civil) 90 minutes 100 (General topics - 50 marks; Technical Ability - 50 marks)
Section Controller / Station Master / Commercial Supervisor / Goods Train Manager 90 minutes 100 (General Science, Basic Maths & Aptitude, General Awareness & Reasoning)
Technician-III (Mechanical) 90 minutes 100 (1 mark each - General Science, Mathematics, General Intelligence/Reasoning/Awareness)
ESTM-III (S&T) 90 minutes 100 (General topics - 80 marks; Technical Ability - 20 marks)
Assistant Loco Pilot 90 minutes 100 (General topics - 60 marks; Technical Ability - 40 marks)
Track Maintainer 90 minutes 100 (Basic Science, Basic Mathematics, General Awareness & Current Affairs)

The full unit-wise technical syllabus for each post - covering subjects such as Engineering Mechanics, Strength of Materials, Building Materials & Construction, Surveying, Thermal Engineering, Basic Electricity/Electronics, and related topics - is detailed separately in the official notification (Section 14.7 to 14.14) and should be reviewed in full by candidates preparing for the CBT.

CBT Qualifying Marks

Post Category UR & EWS OBC-NCL, SC & ST
Group 'C' posts 50% 40%
Erstwhile Group 'D' post (Track Maintainer) 40% 30%

These are minimum qualifying marks; the actual cutoff may be higher depending on the number of candidates clearing the minimum. Qualifying marks are relaxed by 2% for PwBD candidates.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Physical Efficiency Test (Track Maintainer)

Criteria Male Candidates Female Candidates
Weight Carrying Lift & carry 35 kg for 100 meters in 2 minutes Lift & carry 20 kg for 100 meters in 2 minutes
Running 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds

PET is mandatory and qualifying in nature, conducted in two stages - Weight Carrying first, followed by a Running Test. Failing the Weight Carrying stage results in elimination at that stage itself.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

Category Examination Fee
UR / OBC-NCL / General candidates Rs. 1,180/- (Rs. 1,000 + 18% GST) + payment gateway charges, per examination
SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / Female / Minorities / EBC / PwBD Fee is refunded (minus bank charges) upon appearing in the CBT

Fee is payable online only, through Internet Banking, Debit/Credit Cards, or UPI. Minorities include Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Zoroastrians (Parsis). Economically Backward Class (EBC) candidates - annual family income below Rs. 50,000 - get fee concession only, not job reservation. There is no refund for erroneous, incomplete, or rejected applications.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Documents Required

Candidates should keep scanned copies of the following ready before filling the online application:

  • Recent colour passport-size photograph (JPEG, 30–70 KB, plain white background, no cap/dark glasses)
  • Scanned signature in running handwriting (JPEG, 30–70 KB)
  • SC/ST certificate (for candidates seeking free rail travel passes)
  • PwBD candidates: additional passport-size photograph as per specification, and Scribe details/photograph if applicable

At the time of Document Verification (DV), candidates must produce original documents along with self-attested photocopies, including:

  • Matriculation/High School Certificate (proof of Date of Birth and qualification)
  • HSC, Graduation, and ITI/NCVT-SCVT certificates as applicable
  • Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
  • Domicile certificate (Maharashtra/Goa/Karnataka)
  • SC/ST/OBC-NCL caste certificate in the prescribed Annexure format, where applicable
  • Income Certificate for EBC fee waiver / EWS Income & Asset Certificate, where applicable
  • PwBD certificate as per the prescribed Annexure, where applicable
  • NOC from current employer (for serving Govt./PSU employees) and discharge certificate (for Ex-Servicemen)
  • Land Loser candidates: SLAO Land Loser Certificate, Tehsildar's certificate, proof of relationship, and RTC land documents, as applicable

Also Read: RRB Section Controller Recruitment 2026 (CEN 03/2026): 119 Vacancies, Apply Online

How to Apply for KRCL Recruitment 2026

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online for KRCL Recruitment 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official KRCL website, www.konkanrailway.com, once the application link goes live (tentatively last week of August 2026).
  2. Register your name on the portal; a Registration Number will be generated and sent via registered email and mobile number, along with a password and application link.
  3. Activate the link to access the application form and fill in personal, educational, and category details, carefully selecting your post-wise preference (this cannot be changed once submitted).
  4. Pay the prescribed examination fee online for each CBT Examination Group selected, using Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI.
  5. Upload the required scanned documents - photograph, signature, and category certificates (if applicable).
  6. Review all entries carefully, then submit the application before the closing date.
  7. Keep a printed copy of the submitted online application for future reference - do not send it to KRCL by post.

Candidates are advised to apply only through the official KRCL website and to be cautious of fake websites and job racketeers, as KRCL has not appointed any agents or coaching centres on its behalf.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for one or more posts in a single application, in order of preference; once exercised, post preference is final and cannot be changed.
  • KRCL will allot only one post to a selected candidate, based on preference, merit, vacancy position, and qualifying the selection stages - no request for a lower-preference post will be entertained after allotment.
  • Serving Government/PSU employees may apply directly but must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of DV, failing which their candidature will be cancelled.
  • Selected candidates can be posted anywhere within KRCL's area of operation, including project sites; KRCL employees are not eligible for transfer to other Zonal Railways.
  • Candidates must ensure their mobile number and email ID are active throughout the recruitment process, as all communication will be via SMS and email only.
  • Any candidate found using unfair means, impersonation, or furnishing false information will be disqualified and debarred from future KRCL examinations, and is liable for legal action.
  • KRCL reserves the right to change the number of vacancies, cancel the recruitment process in part or full, and reject applications without assigning reasons.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Important Links

  • Official Notification PDF: Click here
  • Official Website: Click here 

Land Loser candidates, Employment Exchange-registered candidates along the Konkan Railway route, domiciles of Maharashtra/Goa/Karnataka, and serving KRCL employees with 3+ years of regular service are eligible, subject to post-wise qualification and age criteria.

Candidates who have completed a Diploma or Degree in Engineering can also explore more Diploma Government Jobs and Engineering Government Jobs available across India. Candidates interested in railway sector opportunities can also check the latest Railway Recruitment 2026 notifications from RRB and other railway zones. Those looking for openings closer to the region can browse Maharashtra Government Jobs and Goa Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. 10th and 12th pass candidates can also explore more ITI Government Jobs and Track Maintainer Jobs matching their qualification.

How to Download the RRB Ministerial & Isolated Categories Answer Key 2026?

  1. Visit the official website of your respective RRB region, or use the common portal link.
  2. Look for the notification link titled "CEN No. 08/2025 - Ministerial and Isolated Categories Answer Key 2026" under the Latest Updates or Answer Key/Objection section.
  3. Click the link, which will redirect to the login page.
  4. Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth/Password in the login fields.
  5. Click "Login" to view your recorded responses, question paper, and the provisional answer key.
  6. Use the "Save/Print" option to download the answer key and response sheet as a PDF.

Candidates are advised to take a printout of both the answer key and their response sheet for offline review.

How to Calculate Marks Using the RRB MI Answer Key?

The RRB Ministerial & Isolated Categories CBT carries 100 marks for 100 questions. Use the following marking scheme to estimate your score:

  • Correct Answer: +1 mark
  • Incorrect Answer: -1/3 (0.33) mark deducted
  • Unattempted Question: 0 marks

Formula: Total Marks = (Number of Correct Answers × 1) - (Number of Wrong Answers × 0.33)

How to Raise Objections Against the RRB MI Answer Key 2026?

  1. Log in to the official answer key portal using your Registration Number and Date of Birth/Password.
  2. Locate the "Raise Objection" or "Challenge Answer Key" option on your dashboard.
  3. Select the specific question ID and the answer option you believe is incorrect.
  4. Upload a valid justification or supporting reference (textbook page, authoritative source, etc.) for each challenged question. Objections without proof are not considered.
  5. Pay the objection fee of Rs. 50 per question (plus applicable bank charges) via Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI, or Net Banking.
  6. Submit the form and save the confirmation/acknowledgement for future reference.

Particulars Details

Refund Policy Fee refunded (minus bank charges) if the objection is found valid
Objection Window 31 July 2026 (11:55 PM) to 7 August 2026 (11:55 PM)
Payment Modes Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI, Net Banking

Objections submitted after the closing date, or through email/post, will not be entertained.

Important Instructions

  • Only the provisional answer key is currently available; scores calculated using it are estimates, not final.
  • The final answer key will be released after review of all valid objections received during the window.
  • The official result will be based on the final answer key, not the provisional one.
  • Use only official RRB regional websites or the authorized login portal to access the answer key — avoid unofficial third-party links for login.
  • Keep your Registration Number and Date of Birth/Password handy before attempting to log in.

  • Candidates must carry either their original Aadhaar card or a printout of e-verified Aadhaar.

  • Even candidates who verified Aadhaar during the application stage must ensure their Aadhaar status is "unlocked" in the UIDAI system before arriving at the centre. A locked Aadhaar can cause avoidable delays during registration on exam day.
  • Candidates are advised to check their Aadhaar lock/unlock status on the official UIDAI portal a few days before the exam.

  • Revise core subjects: Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Science, and General Awareness on Current Affairs.

  • Keep login credentials for rrbapply.gov.in ready for Aadhaar verification and e-call letter download.
  • Check the official RRB regional website regularly for exam city, date, and admit card updates specific to your phase.

  1. Hearing – Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.

RPSC Sr. Teacher Marking Scheme

  • -1/3 mark deducted for every incorrect answer (negative marking).

  3. Select "Question Objection" for the Sr. Teacher (Sec. Edu.) Comp. Exam 2025.
  4. Choose the subject, paper, and question number as per the Model Question Paper (not your individual set order).
  5. Upload authentic supporting proof standard reference books such as NCERT texts or Board of Secondary Education Rajasthan textbooks; coaching notes or blog links are not accepted.
  6. Pay the objection fee (Rs. 100 per question in earlier batches) via e-Mitra, net banking, or card.
  7. Submit and download the acknowledgement receipt.

  • Objections not supported by authentic reference material are typically rejected.

How to Raise an Online Objection Against the Answer Key

Candidates can follow these steps to submit an objection through the CGPSC website:

  1. Visit the official CGPSC website and log in to the candidate dashboard.
  2. Go to the Activity Section and click on Objection Filing.
  3. On the new page, select the exam name, question paper, set, and the question number you want to object to.
  4. Select the applicable type of objection (see list below).
  5. Clearly write the reason for the objection in the box provided.
  6. Upload supporting proof as a PDF document (maximum size 1MB per question). Proof must include the source name, author, edition/publication date, and reference page number — mere links or website names without this detail will not be accepted.
  7. Use the Add button to submit multiple objections; unwanted entries can be removed before final submission.
  8. Click Save after entering all objections.
  9. Proceed to the fee payment page and click Pay Now to pay Rs. 50 per question for all objections raised.
  10. After successful payment, download the acknowledgement/receipt from the Dashboard under Activity Section > Download Acknowledgement.

Types of Objections Accepted

Objection Type Description
All Answer Options Incorrect All given options for a question are wrong
Commission's Answer Option Incorrect The answer option released by the commission is wrong
More Than One Correct Option More than one answer option is correct
Question is Wrong The question itself is incorrect
Question Out of Syllabus The question is not part of the prescribed syllabus
Hindi-English Translation Mismatch There is a factual difference between the Hindi and English translation of the question

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Objections can be submitted only through the online mode; no offline application or document will be accepted at the commission office.
  • Candidates get only one opportunity to submit all objections together; once the fee is paid, the process is considered complete and objections cannot be filed again.
  • Candidates are responsible for avoiding phishing, hacking, or other cyber risks during online banking/payment.
  • If the fee payment is unsuccessful, if entries are made in different sets of the same question paper, or if the prescribed process is not followed correctly, the submitted objection will be automatically rejected, and no request/appeal regarding this will be entertained by the commission.

Direct update from the official career portal recruitment portal.

  • Company: Lenskart
  • Location: Pune
  • Compensation: ₹ 3,00,000 - 3,50,000 ₹ 3,00,000 - 3,50,000 /year
  • Experience: No experience required
Key Skills
MultitaskingProblem SolvingClient RelationshipEnglish Proficiency (Spoken)English Proficiency (Written)AdaptabilitySales
Role Snapshot
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store. Key responsibilities: A. Customer focus: 1. Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up. 2. He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers. 3. He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively. 4. He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has. B. Product recommendation: 1. With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales. 2. He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions. C. Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence: 1. Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently. 2. Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage. D. Store upkeep & maintenance: 1. He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly. 2. He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store. Note: This role requires working 6 days a week with a rotational week-off and rotational shifts based on business requirements. Please note that there are no night shifts. Training information: Candidates selected for the role after successfully completing the interview process will be attending a one month mandatory offline training program at a designated Lenskart Academy, which is an integral part of the onboarding process. Performance-based incentives will be provided

no inbound ports, no vpn. agents connect outbound over https (port 443) to google's firebase infrastructure. if your network allows general internet access, it just works. locked-down environments may need to whitelist *.googleapis.com and *.firebaseio.com.

roost is owlette's project sync. point it at a folder â a TouchDesigner project, a content drop, a build output â and it ships only the bytes that changed to every machine on the site, atomically: a machine gets the whole new version or stays on the old one, never a half-copied mess. every deploy is versioned, so you can roll back to any of the last 50 for up to 30 days. it's part of the pro tier and includes 1 TB of storage per site ($0.05/GB after that). no more zipping a folder and RDP-ing into ten machines at 2am.

agents connect over tls, credentials are encrypted on-device using a machine-bound key, and oauth tokens are never logged or stored in plaintext. access is managed through firebase auth with optional passkey and two-factor authentication.
